For a poster, bring your file to the Leavey computing center. ITS staff are on site during opening hours.
For a 3D print, email spaces@usc.edu with your request.

video-interview.idea: A two-minute video interview with a professor for a class project. I need a camera, a microphone and a quiet place to film.

needs.why: Need a camera to film the interview.
Need a microphone for clear audio.

steps.title: Plan your interview
steps.detail: Write down your interview questions and check how long your two-minute video will take.

steps.title: Reserve the studio
steps.detail: Email spaces@usc.edu to reserve the podcast studio, or call the ITS Learning Environments team at (213) 821-6601.

steps.title: Record the interview
steps.detail: Go to the Digital Creative Lab in Leavey Library at your reserved time and use the studio equipment to record.

routes.process: Record the interview in a podcast studio

warnings.fix: Practice reading your questions beforehand to keep the interview concise.

first_visit: Go to Digital Creative Lab, Leavey Library, lower level. Podcast studio, fall and spring: Monday to Friday 9 AM to 7 PM, Saturday and Sunday 9 AM to 5 PM. Summer hours differ; see the official page. Hours for the rest of the lab are not listed.
Email spaces@usc.edu to reserve the podcast studio, or call the ITS Learning Environments team at (213) 821-6601.
The e-sports lab is by reservation. The page does not say how to use the production studio, plotters or 3D printer, so ask the same team.
You will likely need your USC ID.
